mechanism: Deployment orders/orders-api sets .spec.template.spec.containers[api].readinessProbe.httpGet.port to 8081 while the api container listens on 8080 ("orders-api: serving on :8080", containerPort 8080), so the kubelet's readiness HTTP GET is refused — 'Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.244.0.122:8081/": dial tcp 10.244.0.122:8081: connect: connection refused' — and the kubelet keeps both pods marked Ready=False (deployment ready=0/2) as the probe repeats every 5s.
